# Fúxī and the industries that were always telling its story
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Fúxī** never stopped working.

Fúxī's myths are all acts of notation: he does not fight or flee — he observes, abstracts, and teaches. He is the culture-bringer as draftsman.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Fúxī
- **Pantheon:** Chinese
- **Domain of influence:** Culture, Writing, Divination
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Technology & Innovation
- **Strongest seat:** Education, Research & Knowledge
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 82 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**Reading the World.** The Yìjīng's Great Treatise records the founding act: Fúxī looked up and contemplated the images of heaven, looked down and contemplated the patterns of earth, contemplated the markings of birds and beasts and the order of the near at hand — and from all three made the eight trigrams, "to comprehend the powers of the spirits and to classify the natures of the ten thousand things. " Writing, mathematics, and divination begin as one gesture of attention. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Dragon-Horse's Map.** Later tradition gives the revelation a courier: a dragon-horse rose from the Yellow River bearing on its back the Hétú, the River Chart — the arrangement of numbers and marks from which Fúxī drew the trigrams.  Paired with the Luò River Writing that inspired the Great Plan, the Chart made the Yellow River itself the first text of Chinese civilization. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Education, Research & Knowledge

*Schools, universities, and research institutions. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The first teacher; nets, notes, and the reading of patterns.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Fúxī performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Software, Cloud & Developer Infrastructure

*Programming languages, cloud systems, and developer tools. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The trigrams: broken and unbroken lines — the binary alphabet three millennia early.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services

*Astrology apps, tarot, and spiritual guidance. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The Yìjīng’s trigrams are his; divination’s founding draftsman.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Fúxī's myths are all acts of notation: he does not fight or flee — he observes, abstracts, and teaches. The age changed. The work did not.

If you work in education, research & knowledge, software, cloud & developer infrastructure, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it.
